quotes.text: If the AI revolution compares to automobiles overtaking horse-drawn wagons, let's be clear: Artificial intelligence is still in its Model-T era. As elected representatives, we are obligated to safeguard emerging technologies from abuse and prevent unforeseen harm. [...] Like most tools, AI is not inherently good or evil. It depends on how it is developed, deployed, and by whom. [...] In responsible hands, with responsible regulations, AI can be indispensable in countering hatred online rather than intensifying it.

Alarmingly, AI technology is only proving to be a super-spreader of animus and intolerance. I am grateful to the ADL for partnering with the Task Force on such a critical component of our collective effort to combat online antisemitism.

This week, as Co-Chair of the Interparliamentary Task Force to Combat Online Antisemitism, I joined global leaders and the ADL, to strategize with and push tech companies on how to get ahead of the spread of antisemitism through AI, especially in light of Hamas’ attack on Israel. https://t.co/hIqujwmaSc

Grateful to work alongside an ally like @DavidLega last week to confront the challenge of online antisemitism increasingly driven by AI. His work and words always inspire, and I'm proud to call him a friend. https://t.co/oVdwrM65Ac

Social media antisemitism was surging pre-10/7 and skyrocketed after Hamas' massacre. Elon's embrace of extremism and X mismanagement make it worse. In @Newsweek, @AHousefather and I explain how AI can solve online hate & real-life violence - not fuel it. https://t.co/88ICtlFP4S
